title: Rights of entry and call for information
rule: A person authorised by the Director may enter and inspect land (other than a dwelling house) between 6 am and 6 pm, on at least 48 hours' notice, for any purpose connected with implementing the Act. The Director may also require a licence holder to provide information by registered post.
points: Entry excludes land occupied exclusively as a dwelling house (s.104(1)).
The 48-hour notice and 6 am to 6 pm window are the baseline; this is a narrower, general-purpose power distinct from the search/seizure powers in s.93.
s.105 lets the Director demand information in writing from any licence holder, for any purpose connected with implementing the Act.
checks: Licence holder status (for s.105 information requests)
